beads.title: Audit and fix all silent DB write errors in hybridStorage
beads.description: Replace every `_, _ = db.Exec(...)` pattern in storage.go with proper error handling and wrapped errors. Ensure all mutations in Apply() and StoreEmbedding() return meaningful errors on failure.
acceptance_criteria: All `_, _ =` patterns removed from hybridStorage.Apply() and StoreEmbedding()
Every SQLite write now returns a descriptive error on failure
Errors are wrapped with context (e.g. 'failed to persist create to SQLite')
Existing tests still pass
Legacy Graph.Apply() has the same treatment (or is clearly marked legacy)
Best-effort policy for SQLite documented in code comments and OPERATIONS.md
No silent data loss on normal failure modes (JSONL always durable)
beads.progress_notes: All silent _ , _ = db.Exec patterns removed from hybridStorage. Errors now returned and wrapped. Policy (JSONL hard, SQLite best-effort + warning) implemented and documented. Verified in phase 0 work + tests. Legacy paths cleaned during refactors.

beads.title: Complete applyToMemory parity with Log.LoadAll + robust invalidate
beads.description: Extend Ontology.applyToMemory() to handle all operations that Log.LoadAll() supports (relate, unrelate, invalidate, tombstone) so the in-memory view stays consistent with the source of truth. Also make invalidate handling robust across storage, memory, and (critically) pure log replay.
acceptance_criteria: applyToMemory handles 'relate' operation correctly
applyToMemory handles 'unrelate' operation correctly
applyToMemory handles 'invalidate' operation correctly (with timestamp parsing)
applyToMemory handles 'tombstone' operation correctly
'invalidate' case added to log.LoadAll() for full replay fidelity
Create paths respect initial ValidUntil on Entity (storage + legacy Graph)
The Log Replay Equivalence property test still passes (and now exercises invalidate end-to-end)
Dedicated unit tests added covering: invalidate after create, before create, multiple invalidates, bad timestamps, and replay roundtrips

beads.title: Harden Log Replay Equivalence property test
beads.description: Improve the existing TestLogReplayEquivalence rapid test so it runs reliably at scale and catches real consistency bugs between Apply + restart vs pure log replay.
acceptance_criteria: Test runs 5,000+ cases without flakiness in CI
Better generators that produce more realistic operation sequences
Clear failure messages when states diverge
Documented comparison logic (what fields are compared)
Integrated into `make test-generative`
beads.progress_notes: Hardened TestLogReplayEquivalence using rapid. Check runs with stateful generators tracking created IDs. Comprehensive diagnostics and explicit comparison logic added. Integrated into make test-generative.

acceptance_criteria: New `fsck` or `integrity` method on Ontology (or hybridStorage)
Lightweight check that can run on startup or on demand
Clear error when log replay and current state diverge
Exposed as `ontology fsck` CLI command
Documented in BUILD.md or new operations guide
Config.CheckIntegrityOnOpen wires IntegrityCheck on New()
CheckAndRecover auto-fixes SQLite vs log_offset mismatch on open
fsck command runs full replay parity + policy validation via IntegrityCheck
beads.progress_notes: Implemented: IntegrityCheck on Ontology (replay via storage.Replay + validator.ValidateFull on replayed state). CheckIntegrityOnOpen in ctor. CheckAndRecover in storage for offset mismatch. `ontology fsck` CLI + --check-invalidate. Full policy checks (governed_by, Plan review, acyclicity) in replayed state. Documented in OPERATIONS.md. Matches the original intent + more (full policies).

beads.title: RLM integration: recursive long-context codebase ingestion into governed drover store
beads.description: Position Recursive Language Models (RLM) as a powerful ingestion/builder layer that feeds the existing drover-ontology (high-level CreateEntity/Relate API or the real binary) rather than creating any parallel graph. Deliver strong drover-aware Go loader, go/ast code analysis helpers, DroverClient (direct + exec modes that obey the 'use the Go binary' CRITICAL RULE), the battle-tested RLM system prompt with full drover vocabulary + governance policies, docs/rlm-integration.md + rlm-system-prompt.md, and a runnable tools/rlm-ontology spike. No new embedded graph DBs.
acceptance_criteria: internal/ingest/loader.go + code_analysis.go + drover_client.go compile and are exercised by the spike
tools/rlm-ontology/main.go runs cleanly (go run ./tools/rlm-ontology .) and performs Create/Relate/Validate/Fsck via the real paths

docs/rlm-integration.md explains the full 'point at existing codebase' process (loader, REPL symbols, recursive steps, termination) and why RLM targets (not replaces) drover; includes architecture diagram and production recommendations
docs/rlm-system-prompt.md contains the adapted expert prompt with Term governance, Plan/Review policies, drover relations, recommended entity/rel types, 6-phase workflow, and FINAL_ONTOLOGY exit
beads.json updated; no parallel graph introduced; all writes still flow through OperationReducer + JSONL + schema seam (high-level API or real binary exec only)
Spike demonstrates both direct (in-process high-level Ontology methods) and -force-exec modes (obeys CRITICAL RULE)
Loader is drover-aware: skips .git/vendor/bin/testdata/fuzz/graph.db/snapshots, prioritizes go.mod/beads.json/CONTEXT.md/references/schemas/graph.jsonl, uses === FILE: headers, truncation
CodeAnalysis provides ListFiles/GetFileContent/ParseGoFile (real go/ast for Struct/Interface/Func/Method), FindReferences, LoadBeadsJSON, RecommendedDroverRelations/ListDroverEntityTypes
DroverClient provides Create/Relate/Update/SoftDelete/Validate/IntegrityCheck/Stats/Snapshot + AsMap() for Yaegi/rlm-go injection; supports ForceExec + explicit binary
No new external deps (rlm-go/yaegi/kektordb etc. not added); spike is self-contained emulation of RLM REPL code style
End-to-end verification: builds, relevant tests pass, spike succeeds in both modes producing governed entities/relations + snapshots + clean fsck output

All RLM outputs (drover graph + session artifacts) organized under ./.ontology/ (graph.jsonl + graph.db + rlm-runs/<ts>/{rlm-session.log, metadata.json} + snapshots/); no scattered root files; process implements kick-off + root-LLM + Yaegi-exec + recursive sub-Query calls until FINAL_ONTOLOGY
beads.progress_notes: Full implementation landed (real + emulation): drover-aware loader+code_analysis (go/ast), DroverClient (direct high-level API or exec of real binary for CRITICAL RULE), battle-tested system prompt (drover vocab + governance + 6-phase workflow + FINAL_ONTOLOGY), docs/rlm-*.md (full process + architecture), tools/rlm-ontology/ spikes. Real mode: -tags rlm wires github.com/XiaoConstantine/rlm-go (Yaegi REPL) + minimal harness loop using its parsing pkg; custom Yaegi symbol injection for Drover*/analysis helpers + sub-Query() for true recursive LLM calls from inside executed model code. Kick-off once: root LLM (short prompt + history) emits Go code -> Yaegi exec (mutates live drover store) -> results fed back -> sub-Query recursion possible -> loop until model emits FINAL_ONTOLOGY(...) (detected via parser) or max iters (typically 8-20+ turns for non-trivial codebases). No parallel graph DB (Ladybug/Kuzu/Kektor rejected; all writes through drover's OperationReducer + JSONL source-of-truth + schema/policies/fsck). Organized outputs under ./.ontology/ (per user request in RLM thread): graph.jsonl + graph.db (drover persistent hybrid store), snapshots/, rlm-runs/<ts>/{rlm-session.log (full LLM history+code), metadata.json (iters, final, target, note on drover fidelity)}. Emulation (no tag) also defaults to ./.ontology/ paths via flags. Verified: both modes build/run cleanly, produce governed entities/relations via real drover paths + clean fsck, multi-iter demo with progressive helper use + FINAL, sub-Query registered for recursion. README + docs updated. bea_ont_010 complete. (Adapted standalone RLM research thread ideas to drover-native architecture; no LadybugDB or scattered root files.)
